Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: production brand square brand emblem for website and mobile.
Input image: the attached local image is the exact edit target.
Primary request: remove ONLY the off-white/white exterior background and make it genuinely transparent with an alpha channel. Preserve the exact subject pixels, composition, perspective, 3D shading, vivid pink/red/orange/yellow colors, geometry, edge antialiasing and relative layout. This is faithful background removal, NOT a redesign or recreation. Remove background in the open negative spaces between the icon, lettering, underline, and surrounding detached decorative strokes. Keep the white calendar paper and white ribbon edges which are intrinsic parts of the emblem fully opaque. The interior calendar face and heart centre should remain white paper, not become holes. No added shadow or glow; no white matte or checkerboard drawn into the image.
No text. Keep all three detached celebratory rays, full calendar and ribbon in frame. Maintain a square canvas.
Constraints: no changes to logo design, no added elements, no new typography, no new background. Deliver one clean transparent PNG asset, no contact sheet.
